emotional_tone: Vibrant, welcoming, trustworthy, tropical but premium. Evokes the warmth of the sun and the clarity of Bahamian waters while ensuring a frictionless booking experience.

headings.usage: H1-H4, large expressive metrics. Adds editorial, travel-magazine elegance.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, data tables, and standard UI components. Ensures high readability.

mono.usage: Booking references, tracking IDs, admin dashboard data.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Tint greys with ocean blue.
Use Coral Pink (#FF7F50) exclusively for high-conversion CTAs (Book Now, Pay).
Turquoise (#00B4D8) is for branding, active states, and sub-actions.
Deep Navy (#1A365D) for strong contrast text and footer backgrounds.

marketing_pages: Generous spacing: use py-24 or py-32 for sections to let the Caribbean imagery breathe.
Hero Sections: Immersive full-bleed images with a backdrop-blur-md glassmorphism booking widget floating on top.
The 'Bento' Grid for Excursions: Use asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 for showcasing tours. e.g., Hero image col-span-8, side features col-span-4.
Overlap elements: Break the box by allowing images to overlap sections using -mt-12 or similar.
dashboard_pages: Dense, functional bento grids for Admin metrics.
Use subtle rounded borders (rounded-xl) and 1px border-border.
Flat Solid surfaces, no glassmorphism for admin tables to keep data crisp.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (Customer): For sticky navs and floating booking bars over hero images. Use bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20.
Flat Solid (Admin): Solid backgrounds with strict 1px borders.
shadows: Use soft ambient shadows for cards: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)].
motion: Smooth entrance fades and staggered lists for tour options using framer-motion.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly on active (scale-95).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for customer-facing CTAs. Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md) for Admin dashboard. Never default to generic rectangular buttons.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Minimalist floating labels or large, airy inputs with p-6 and bg-transparent border-b-2 focus:border-primary. Dropdowns should never have transparent backgrounds.
components.cards: Borderless cards with soft image overlays. When hovering over a tour card, image scales slightly and a gradient overlay reveals the price/book button.
components.tables: Admin only. Dense, left-aligned, sticky header.
components.tracker: Horizontal stepper for desktop, vertical for mobile. Use lucide-icons with primary color for completed steps.

hero_backgrounds.description: Clear water beach for main homepage hero

vehicles.description: Luxury SUV for taxi and car rentals

accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio is above 4.5:1. Pay special attention to white text over light turquoise or coral.
Use text-shadow on hero images if text is placed directly over imagery.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for components if the project uses JS.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the customer facing pages (Home, Taxi Booking, Tours, Car Rentals, Tracker, Checkout) using the Caribbean Luxury Neuter theme.
Implement the Admin Dashboard using a clean, strict grid.
Setup routing using React Router for these pages.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text by linking them in index.html.
Add framer-motion for smooth page transitions and micro-interactions.
Use the provided image URLs to replace placeholders.
Ensure the booking tracking flow includes visual states (Confirmed, Driver Assigned, En Route, Arrived, Completed) using a stepped progress bar.
Include payment UI mocking Stripe checkout and providing Zelle manual instructions.
Add a Facebook page link integration for 'roxtaxiservice'.
Ensure responsive design (mobile-first) is fully functional, especially the booking widgets.
